title: x-relay/eval-dataset-result
description: Relay EvalRun extension for ACEF bundles. Spec table line 867: include dataset digest, cases, thresholds, score, failed assertions. Generated under bundle.namespaces['x-relay']['eval-dataset-result'].

dataset_digest.description: sha256 of the canonicalised dataset used for the eval run.

score.description: Aggregate score in [0, 1]; lower-is-better metrics are inverted before recording.

threshold.description: Pass threshold the eval was gated against; null if untested.
